what: The stitch-mesh experiment's settle settings, frozen 2026-11-19 before its measured yarn-settle runs (the numbers and rules guided_settle_defaults_frozen compares with the code's defaults).

conversion.representation: per open strand, one uniform cubic B-spline interpolating equal-arc points of the dense Hermite strand (natural ends); each piece keeps its parameter interval

solve.values_from: production SettleParams / RepairParams / PatternParams defaults (settle.h, params.h); hard thresholds and margins are the solver's own (knit_numerics.cpp)
solve.radius_continuation: start diameter D0 by certifiedRepair's rule from the certified checks of the converted curves; stages D_k = D0 (D / D0)^(k / K), K = ceil(log(D / D0) / log 1.6), from max(D0, 0.05 mm); then 6 calls at D
solve.per_call: hard contact D_k + c (+ 0.03), hard curvature 1 / (r_k + c / 2) / 1.03, soft targets as settle's, displacement cap 0.5 (D_{k-1} + c); first 3 and last 3 controls pinned (the two declared yarn ends)
solve.budget: at most 900 LM steps and 40 outer iterations per call (the solver's own limits); no call starts after 50 min of solve time (the one-hour cap of every run)
solve.stop_rule: calls at the target end at the first one whose gate is valid and whose construction is kept; a valid gate on a changed construction ends the run as lost; 4 target calls in a row with neither fewer open regions nor a smaller shortfall end it as stalled; at most 60 target calls, the 50 min budget before that on large pieces
